items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: the leader of the group was a pianist named Nat Walker... Then something happened to Nat, and he wigged out. He says, 'Why didn't you all let me know that you didn't want me to be the leader of the band?'

ctx.x: Which chorus line are you talking about, the Ubangi or --
Yes, at the Ubangi. It was about three shuffle Along girls left from the Ubangi -- I mean, from the Show. And then they got a couple more Los Angeles girls to put in there.
So when I got the bass job, when the bass player went home, and that left it a septet -- seven pieces. And at that time, Nat could only sing one song.
